name: F₁Fₒ ATP Synthase — Live Four-Channel Transduction
description: Fig 6 as a fully runnable temporal study: the F₁Fₒ ATP synthase as a molecular transducer that couples a proton-motive force across four TYPED physical channels. A ProtonMotiveRamp charges the substrate/proton drive (chemical_in) linearly over the run — the fig06 analogue of fig04's diffusing gradient — so the driving proton flux sweeps upward and MolecularMechanismHandler converts ONE coupled quantity into: ATP synthesis flux (chemical_out), a proton current across the PMF (electrical_out), a near-constant rotary torque on the Fₒ rotor (mechanical_out), and the non-conserved remainder as heat (thermal_out). All four derive from the single proton flux, so matter/charge/angular-momentum/energy are conserved: input PMF power (i_proton·pmf) = useful work + dissipated heat. This is the demonstration behind Fig 6b. Runnable (default_n_steps + RAMEmitter).
